processes.name: Cooling-material solidification
processes.module: Gradient furnace and dedicated sample ampoule

layers.name: Telemetry, timestamps, batch records
layers.detail: Common event schema and data service. Product-specific acceptance logic stays with each recipe.

layers.name: Power distribution and heat rejection
layers.detail: Share the bus and radiator only within measured peak power, heat, transient and fault-isolation limits.

layers.name: Imaging and metrology
layers.detail: Time-share when optics, field of view, cleanliness and sampling cadence are compatible. Critical simultaneous observations need separate instruments.

layers.name: Growth cells and wetted paths
layers.detail: Separate chemistry, sterility and contamination boundaries. Similar process steps do not make fluid circuits interchangeable.

layers.name: Furnaces, magnets and mixers
layers.detail: Material-specific ranges, gradients and field geometry. Characterize magnetic, vibration and thermal coupling before co-location.

layers.name: Storage, return and qualification
layers.detail: Shared logistics require compatible preservation and hazard classes. Qualification remains specific to the material and application.

limits: Power and heat values are placeholder design loads, not sourced flight hardware specifications. This screening model is not flight qualification. A pass requires isolated cartridges and does not imply common fluids, chemistry, or shared internal equipment.
